verdict.rationale: Godot supports bulk-style automation through EditorScript (run custom _run() code against many nodes/resources from the editor), headless CLI mode for scripted batch operations, and documented ability to change import parameters across multiple assets simultaneously. However, there is no dedicated bulk-operation API or explicit AI-native batch tooling — these are general-purpose scripting/CLI primitives repurposed for bulk work, and no official MCP server or agent-oriented bulk endpoint exists (community MCP servers are third-party and fragmented). Missing for 10: a first-party bulk/batch API or documented workflow explicitly for AI agents to act on many items at once, and independent hands-on evidence of this being used at scale.
